answer: New identities start at the base of a knoll, where trust is low and rewards are minimal, so spinning up many fake participants yields near-zero return. Each agent must stake a unique quartz token mined on-chain, and reputation accrues along an upward spiral tied to verified work history. Attacker cost is the staked quartz plus lost reputation, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. In practice, sa0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
